entry.title: Gone, I'm Gone
entry.summary:
Author: vanifly

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 4,926Chapters: 1/?Kudos: 5

Summary: Arthur had found that quite odd—he had never cared to listen in to castle gossip, especially not when he's already annoyed. Something about the conversation had struck him as weird. It wasn't until he started listening again did he understand why. Merlin. They were talking about Merlin. It's good to know that he's still in the castle and didn't just leave without warning. Arthur still needed his armor polished for training tomorrow. Now, look, Arthur wasn't one to eavesdrop—unless he was told to, he didn't care if people knew if he was listening or not, especially not servants—but he couldn't help the feeling that whatever they were talking about was something neither wanted anyone else to hear. It was something he needed to hear; he felt it. Thus, why he started eavesdropping. "Did you hear what's happened to Merlin?" the girl who pulled the other into the alcove asked. "Merlin?" the other replied. "No, I haven't. What's going on?" "Apparently," the girl started with a whisper, "Merlin is being accused of sorcery."
